track: Northstar wardrobe base figure (D-197/D-198) — separate from the R3 shadow stack; the R3 contract's authorisedCalls and its derived image-call budget are not changed by this file

meta.rule: Authorisation is never a general boolean. Only an entry below, UNSPENT, verified field by field from origin/main by tools/avatar/openai-send-northstar-base-figure-d199.mjs, can be sent — and only on a separate, explicit owner instruction after this file is merged (D-183 §8 pattern). Merging is not an instruction to run.

budget.ownerApproval: D-199 (owner, 2026-10-25): at most 2 image calls for the base figure — A, and B only as a reserve; no automatic retries, no extra calls, no fallback model; B uses the same frozen request unless the owner approves a concrete change. Not the clothing pilot, not mass production.
budget.countingRule: D-159: every call actually sent counts, whatever its outcome; a consumed claim excludes any further attempt under the same call id.

inputs.purpose: the only reference: Northstar v2's identity, pose, proportions, painting style and coordinates
inputs.name: Northstar Master v2.png

prompt.encoding: UTF-8, LF only, ending in exactly one LF (the frozen D-198 bytes)

outputs.storage: OUTSIDE both clones (D-127 §2): a figure in close-fitting base clothing is never tracked, never placed under assets/, never published

prohibitions.noRetry: Exactly one fetch. No retry, no fallback model, no second call site.
prohibitions.noH1: H1 and anything derived from it are never read, sent or compared.
prohibitions.noMask: No mask, no input_fidelity, no second image.

outputHandling.receipt: the raw response and the image are stored unchanged; the adapter checks only that exactly one decodable 1024×1536 8-bit RGBA PNG arrived (BF1's format part); anything else is a TECHNICAL_REJECT or UNEXPECTED
outputHandling.technicalChecks: BF1–BF15 by tools/avatar/northstar-base-figure.mjs --review, thresholds exactly as base-figure-spec-v1.json at origin/main; no threshold changes after the result
outputHandling.visual: V1–V8 only by the owner; a BF pass is never a visual approval
outputHandling.neverRetouched: the raw image is never changed; registration is an integer shift, recomposition puts the R3 head stack over the body; nothing is painted

calls.status: AUTHORISED — RESERVE, locked until A is recorded as rejected

requiresA.recordedBy: a register row named in A's recordedBy field

calls.sameRequestAsA: B sends exactly A's frozen request (model, parameters, field order, the one image, the prompt bytes). A concrete change needs a separate owner approval and a new decision; this entry would then be closed, not edited.
